title: AndroidAPS seems to sleep starting at 3 am
body:
Hello all together,

a friend of mine has an issue regarding AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1/master.
It looks as it often (maybe always) start sleeping starting at 3 am. Background execution permission in Android is given. The log has not a lot to say instead of "there is no activity between around 3 am and the time the app was clicked in the morning".

When the app is launched in the morning the chart is stuck at around 3 am. After a few seconds the chart is then ok and the calculated basals are put in place on the pump again.

Does anyone have an idea what the issue could be here? My assumption was a missing background execution permission but this is fine. I've no idea. Can anyone help out? Thanks in advance.

comments.body:
Already discussed multiple times on Discord. Tell him/her to stop Google Play Protect in Play Store. As it doesn't "know" AAPS, it is shutting it down.
S/he might have a cleaning app or battery optimization too but Olay Protect is the most probable cause.

Hello @robertrub. I searched Discord for something like hang and 3 am but this search term unfortunately didn't led me to that. Thanks for giving that hint. I'll close this incident and give it a try with deactivating Google Play Protect.

You can look in the FAQ doc attached in #wiki.
Sometimes if you don't have the exact search words, you come out with no results. We're used to the modern search engines "interpreting largely" the search words, but it is not the case in Discord ;)
